description: This file defines an enum 'RecurringDepositType' representing different types of recurring deposit in a savings portfolio within the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods for retrieving enum instances from integers, filtering valid values, and checking validity.

classes.name: RecurringDepositType
classes.description: An enumeration of supported recurring deposit types used in savings, including 'INVALID', 'VOLUNTARY', and 'MANDATORY'. Provides methods for conversion and validation.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the recurring deposit type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code representing the recurring deposit type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding RecurringDepositType; returns INVALID if null or unrecognized.

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values for all valid recurring deposit types (excluding INVALID).

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks whether the current enum instance is INVALID.
